text:
The diagram shows a fire.
Why does the smoke rise above the fire?
A
Smoke evaporates more quickly at higher temperatures.
B
Smoke molecules diffuse more quickly at higher temperatures.
C
The density of the air is lower at higher temperatures.
D
The pressure of the air is greater at higher temperatures.

options.label: A
options.text: Smoke evaporates more quickly at higher temperatures.

options.label: B
options.text: Smoke molecules diffuse more quickly at higher temperatures.

options.label: C
options.text: The density of the air is lower at higher temperatures.
